chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, raising it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Uthman ibn Mazoun said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): 'I have intended to leave the perfume and certain things that he mentioned.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Do not leave the perfume, for the angels inhale the scent of the perfume from the believer, therefore do not leave the perfume on every Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling and significance of using perfume on Fridays according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Uthman ibn Mazoun’s intention to abstain from perfume is gently corrected by the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who highlights the spiritual dimension of scent by noting that angels inhale the fragrance of the believer. This tradition underscores the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and the purification of the self, framing the use of perfume not merely as a physical act but as a means of attracting divine attention and angelic presence, particularly on Fridays as a preparation for communal worship.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Usman Bin Mazoun said to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, ‘I have intended to leave the perfume and certain things’, and he mentioned these. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not leave the perfume, for the Angels desire the aromatic fragrances from the Believer, therefore do not leave the perfume during every Friday’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, “

Uthman ibn Maz‘un once said to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, “I had decided to give up certain things, of which one is perfumes and other things.” The Messenger of Allah said, ‘You must not give up perfume; the angels smell fine perfume from believing people, so you must not ignore applying perfumes on Fridays.’”
